## Type of change

- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New game / variant
- [ ] Feature / enhancement
- [ ] Refactor / cleanup (no behavior change)
- [ ] Performance
- [ ] Docs / tooling / CI

## Screenshots / recordings

## Checklist

- [ ] My branch is up to date with `master` and the diff is focused on a single concern.
- [ ] I ran the app locally and manually verified the affected game(s)/area(s).
- [ ] `npm run lint` and `npm run typecheck` (or equivalent) pass.
- [ ] `npm test` (or the relevant subset) passes.
- [ ] If I added a new game, it is registered in the games index and follows the existing `Game.tsx` / `index.ts` pattern.
- [ ] I updated `CHANGELOG.md` and/or docs if user-visible behavior changed.
- [ ] No secrets, tokens, or personal data are included in the diff.
- [ ] CI is green (or I have explained why it is not).
